sections.heading: Overview
content: This policy outlines Humana’s expectation for reporting codes and other data on claims billed to Humana plans.

sections.heading: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
content: In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements. Unless Humana policy or guidance directs otherwise, Humana requires providers to bill codes and other claims data according to the following:
1. Applicable Original Medicare and Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) guidance, if any; or

2. Otherwise, the applicable industry standard established by the appropriate authority. Examples include: – Current Procedural Terminology (CPT) coding standards by the American Medical Association (AMA); – 837 electronic transaction standards by the American National Standards Institute (ANSI) X12; – International Classification of Diseases, Tenth Revision, Clinical Modifications (ICD-10-CM) coding standards by the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC); and – Standards for reporting institutional claims by the National Uniform Billing Committee (NUBC).

sections.heading: General Humana Resources
content: • Availity – Providers can register for access to information on a variety of topics such as eligibility, benefits, referrals, authorizations, claims and electronic remittances. • Claims processing edit notifications – Alerts of upcoming claims payment changes are posted on the first Friday of each month. • Claims resources – Providers can find information on referrals, authorizations, electronic claim submissions and more. • Making it easier – This page contains an educational series for providers and healthcare professionals. • Medical and pharmacy coverage policies – Humana publishes determinations of coverage of medical procedures, devices and medications for the treatment of various conditions. There may be variances in coverage among plans. • Publications – This page can help you find our quarterly newsletter, provider manual and other resources to help you do business with us. Note : Links to sources outside of Humana’s control are verified at the time of publication. Please report broken links .
